Job Description

The Pricing Data Engineer builds and maintains the data infrastructure and tools that enable consistent, data-driven pricing across the firm while modernizing workflows and reducing reliance on manual processes. This role supports scalable solutions and the integration of AI-driven capabilities to enhance pricing analysis and insights, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to align with firm standards and continuous improvement efforts. The Pricing Data Engineer works under minimal supervision, and relies on significant experience to plan and accomplish objectives.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Design and maintain scalable pricing workflows that support consistent matter scoping, budgeting, and financial analysis across the firm
Build and maintain a centralized pricing data infrastructure, consolidating data from multiple systems to support firmwide pricing
Support the development and maintenance of pricing strategies for AI-enabled legal services and emerging delivery models
Develop and manage data pipelines and queries to support pricing analysis and reporting
Modernize pricing workflows by reducing reliance on manual processes and implementing scalable, system-driven solutions
Design and deliver pricing tools, including budget builders, scenario modeling, and comparable matter analysis interfaces
Integrate AI capabilities into pricing workflows to enhance analysis, forecasting, and decision-making
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support effective pricing, planning, and monitoring of matters through data-driven tools
Establish feedback loops to track performance and continuously improve pricing models, tools, and methodologies
Develop pricing frameworks and unit economics to support AI-enabled legal work, enabling partners to price, monitor, and refine matters
Design pricing processes to be natively executable using AI tools
Design and maintain a centralized pricing data layer to support consistent data access and usability
Enhance data granularity to enable detailed pricing analysis across phase, task, and resource levels
Ensure consistency, transparency, and governance across all pricing data, tools, and methodologies

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or related field preferred
Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building scalable workflows, structured data pipelines, automation, APIs, and reporting solutions
Experience working with AI platforms, automation tools, or AI-enabled workflows preferred
Knowledge of cloud data warehouses and experience with cloud-based data platforms and data visualization/reporting tools preferred

Ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize responsibilities

The American Cancer Society (ACS) is seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our mission-driven team in the fight against cancer. As a key member of ACS’s growing enterprise data practice, the Data Engineer will play a central role in designing, building, and optimizing a modern data ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, and Dbt. Design, develop, and orchestrate modern data pipelines and integrations (30%) — Architect and manage scalable data workflows using Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, dbt, and cloud orchestration tools such as Prefect.io or Airflow, ensuring high performance and reliability.
Implement and manage cloud-based data infrastructure (20%) — Administer and optimize data environments in Microsoft Azure, including Cosmos DB, Snowflake, and related services, performing configuration, monitoring, and cost optimization.
Develop and deploy advanced data engineering solutions (20%) — Utilize Python for complex data transformation, automation, and performance optimization within robust CI/CD pipelines with comprehensive unit testing and peer code reviews.
Integrate data from diverse sources (10%) — Leverage ingestion platforms such as FiveTran, Rivery.io, or OpenFlow to streamline and automate data collection from internal and external systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (10%) — Partner with analytics engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to design and refine data models that power research, visualization, and machine learning initiatives.
Support data governance, security, and documentation (10%) — Implement and enforce best practices for data security, access control, and compliance, including Snowflake user and instance management.

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Biology, or equivalent experience
Years of experience: 3+ years of relevant work experience. 3+ years of building a modern data pipeline, including the ETL, cloud-storage, reporting, and deployment

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

Advanced proficiency in cloud data engineering within Microsoft Azure, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Cosmos DB; experience with Snowflake for data warehousing and administration.
Strong expertise in SQL and Python, including development of complex ETL/ELT workflows, automation scripts, and performance-optimized data transformations.
Hands-on experience with modern orchestration and ingestion platforms such as Prefect.io, Apache Airflow, FiveTran, Rivery.io, or OpenFlow, supporting automated and scalable data movement.
Proven experience implementing CI/CD practices for data engineering — including automated testing, code reviews, version control (e.g., GitHub/GitLab), and deployment pipelines.
Experience designing and managing large-scale, high-density data systems, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data such as genomics, imaging, and biospecimen datasets.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and the ability to translate complex research or analytic requirements into optimized data models.
Strong understanding of healthcare and research data domains, including claims, electronic health records (EHR), survey, and clinical datasets; knowledge of data governance, compliance, and privacy standards (e.g., HIPAA).
Demonstrated collaboration skills working with data scientists, analytics engineers, and researchers to deliver high-quality, reliable, and well-documented data solutions.

Availability and ability to work after hours, weekends, holidays, etc. as needed, to be on call and/or to fulfill job responsibilities and requirements.
